**Security: pass-with-notes**, final C34 round at `808d10d7fb9c2f6cd76ab07198791281b8974aca`, against blocked `a552625169d54b45015c6681b689da334b470987` (output `b07df5a0873adb545c89ae85df43546c5742d542`).

The normal-use uncapped-footer defect is repaired. The footer retains at most three complete release commands and reports the remainder. No scoped vulnerability or remaining blocking normal-use bug was established in this short delta.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No scoped vulnerabilities found; prior footer-cap finding closed | - |

## Repair verified

`notice_next` limits its command list with `LIMIT_RELEASES_SHOWN = 3`, joining only those commands and adding the exact remaining count. It no longer appends every distinct address to the supposedly bounded message.

Request lines and commands remain complete strings rather than byte-sliced text. Existing rendering/word quoting and the request-line budget are unchanged. The new 60-distinct-role/instance/project case checks the entire body, exactly three release commands, the omitted-command count and the first request.

This closes the specific P208-F001 normal-use failure. It is not a generic guarantee for arbitrary malformed stored strings or arbitrary external use of the helper. The disclosed at-least-once recovery after partial stamp failure remains; repeated-fault retry bounds are not newly certified.

## Evidence

Local/remote/GitHub heads agree; shared detached worktree clean; PR CLEAN. The one-file delta was directly inspected; the helper supplied only a no-findings summary.

CI [42585879035](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42585879035) succeeded on merge `43c312e1a9db43eca285c0d60995b71e454ac085`, with this head and actual main `d1f90a870a3589a933cf1510c9194e7851540f8c` as parents; tree `7d7cf9cddbfcb87b4d827d4de99b6e85fdf165a5`.

JUnit artifact [13658708937](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42585879035/artifacts/13658708937) confirms 2,345 passing cases, no failures; six separately skipped. The distinct-address footer-cap test, earlier cap test and gone-holder grouping/all-stamps test executed successfully. Current Node/Rust/Delivers checks succeed; an older Delivers run was cancelled.

Mutants are optional under C34. No local builds/tests, credential reads, mutation/live-system probes or product edits were performed.
